text: Cycling offers low-impact physical activity alongside an enjoyable and eco-conscious method of transit. The bicycle's main task is to push the rider ahead, achieved by turning pedals that rotate the wheels. To decelerate or halt, a rider must operate brakes found on either the front or rear of the frame via levers. Tires are vital parts responsible for grip and steadiness. These rubber components cushion road shocks to maintain a smooth path across changing landscapes. Maintaining correct pressure and performing routine upkeep ensures these tires remain safe and durable over time.
